top_choice_rationale: P001 is a mature, independently confirmed achievement: GLP-1 as an incretin and its action in humans (Holst), identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), and receptor and proglucagon-peptide biology with the therapeutic concept (Drucker), validated by large randomized trials in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The citation is scoped to the discoveries (incretin function and active form) and does not claim the analogue optimisation work. The residual doubt is Mojsov against Habener on the active peptide, which the supplied evidence cannot settle, but it does not justify no award, so P000 is ranked last.
